title: Minnesota AI Nudification Law Upheld by Judge
description: A judge has denied a request to pause a Minnesota law banning AI 'nudification' technology, according to NBC News.

sections.heading: Minnesota AI Nudification Law
paragraphs: A judge has denied a request to pause a Minnesota law banning AI 'nudification' technology, according to NBC News. Kare11.com reports that the judge denied a restraining order to stop the law.

sections.heading: xAI's Request
paragraphs: The request to pause the law was made by Elon Musk's xAI, as reported by NBC News.

sections.heading: Minnesota Leaders' Response
paragraphs: The Austin American-Statesman reports on the response of Minnesota leaders to the xAI suit over the ban on 'nudification' tech.

faq.a: Nudification technology refers to AI technology that can generate nude images or 'nudify' existing images.

faq.q: What was the request made by xAI?
faq.a: xAI requested a pause on a Minnesota law banning AI nudification technology, according to NBC News.
The judge denied the request to pause the law, as reported by Kare11.com.
